claim: For 0-1 Integer Programming and Integer Optimization formulated with the Potts Hamiltonian, the number of oscillators is n and the number of connections is n + 3/2 n(n-1).
falsifier: One can implement the formulation for a given n and count the oscillators and connections to verify the stated numbers.

exclusions: limited to the reported Potts Hamiltonian formulation for 0-1 Integer Programming and Integer Optimization

title: Oscillator-based optimization for integer–number of oscillators theorem

claim: A deep generative model can generate multi-target molecules that are valid, novel, and effective for various complex diseases, demonstrating robustness and generalization across different target pairs.
falsifier: One can train a deep generative model on multi-target ligand data and evaluate the validity, novelty, and effectiveness of generated molecules across multiple target pairs using standard metrics.

conditions: the model is trained on multi-target ligand data
the generation is performed for various target pairs
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported model (MTMol-GPT) and the target pairs and diseases studied; transfer beyond these is unestablished.

title: Generative model to multiple for generation of valid, novel

claim: Composite protein knots can arise through gene duplication and interconnection of knotted homodimers, where two knotted domains become linked in a single chain.
falsifier: The mechanism can be tested by identifying homologous knotted homodimers and checking whether fused single-chain homologs contain composite knots, or by engineering gene fusions of knotted dimers to see if composite knots form.

conditions: The ancestral homodimer contains a simple trefoil knot in each chain
The duplicated genes become fused into a single open reading frame
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported protein families (methyltransferases and carbonic anhydrases) and AlphaFold-predicted structures; transfer to other families or experimental structures is unestablished.

title: Gene duplication and interconnection–Formation of a composite mechanism

claim: The size distribution of microparticles remains constant over deposition time, indicating that particles grow in the plasma before reaching the substrate rather than on the substrate.
falsifier: Measure particle size distribution at multiple deposition times; if constant, it supports in-flight growth; if it increases, it supports surface growth.

exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported PECVD system, argon plasma, tungsten target, and the specific conditions; transfer to other systems is unestablished.

title: Deposition time–Microparticle size distribution mechanism

claim: Single-agent systems exhibit more hallucination in tool parameters and incorrect tool choice compared to multi-agent systems.
falsifier: Compare tool parameter hallucination rates between single-agent and multi-agent configurations on the same tasks.

conditions: evaluated on travel, mortgage, and software domains
using Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Claude 3.0 models
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, tasks, model configurations, and experimental conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Using a single agent–hallucination in tool parameters principle
